summary: SK hynix Inc., a Korean semiconductor manufacturer, filed a Form 6-K to clarify a media report that its U.S. subsidiary Solidigm is pursuing a pre-IPO capital raising of approximately KRW 5 trillion. The company states that no such matters have been determined and that it is reviewing various measures to strengthen competitiveness. This is a routine clarification filing, not a definitive special-situation event. The company will disclose further details when confirmed or within one month. No deal terms or board actions are provided. The filing does not commit to any transaction, and the rumor of a pre-IPO raise remains unconfirmed.
